title: handoff: privacy filter and attachment rate-limit proxy
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Add a configurable PII redaction pipeline to handoff notes and an ephemeral attachment proxy with per-incident and per-user rate limits. Motivation: customers reported accidental PII leakage in handoff notes and large attachments causing spiky egress and long-term retention burdens. This PR implements a layered approach: 1) a lightweight PII classifier + heuristic regex scrubber exposed as internal/handoff/scrubber.go with three redact levels (none, redact-pii, redact-sensitive) and config driven allowlists; 2) an attachment proxy service internal/proxy/attach_proxy.go that accepts multipart uploads, applies size/type heuristics, stores content in an ephemeral blobstore with TTL and returns short access tokens; 3) enforcement of per-incident and per-user upload rate limits via a sliding-window counter stored in Redis with configurable quotas and backoff; 4) telemetry and audit hooks in slo-toolkit for redaction-rates and proxy throttling; 5) docs and runbook updates for oncall handling of throttled uploads. Backwards compatibility: the redaction pipeline is behind feature flag handoff.redaction.enabled=false by default and proxy is optional with handoff.attachments.proxy_url unset by default. Rollout plan: enable in staging for 10% of incidents for 48h, monitor redaction false-positive/false-negative rates and proxy 429 rate, then ramp to 100% if metrics are green. Includes migration to replace legacy long-lived attachment URLs with ephemeral tokens for new uploads only; existing attachments are untouched. Manual rollback: flip feature flags and scale down proxy deployment. Testing: unit tests for scrubber heuristics, integration tests for proxy upload/TTL, e2e handoff smoke tests with redaction enabled. See changed_files for implementation details and a short rollout checklist.

review_comments: Daniel Kim: Prefer the scrubber be opt-in for existing customers; requested a feature flag and a migration note. PRIYA: Added handoff.redaction.enabled flag and migration section in docs; responded with updated description and windows for canary.

Rosa Martinez: Concern about false positives for code snippets and stack traces. Requested escape hatch and an allowlist for monospaced blocks. PRIYA: Added monoblock allowlist and unit tests demonstrating preserved code blocks when marked.

Ethan Blake: Noted potential race condition in Redis quota decrement on concurrent uploads and asked for idempotency. PRIYA: Switched quota logic to use Redis Lua script for atomic check-and-decrement and added a test to simulate concurrent uploads. Asked reviewer to re-check the Lua script; Ethan approved after run.
Rosa Martinez: Asked to add a short privacy note to release notes describing what gets redacted. PRIYA: Added a concise note and pointed to docs/handbook/handoff_privacy.md. Rosa approved.
